cohort_total_n_excerpt: The cases were 130 incident patients with histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate. The controls were 274 hospital inpatients without prostate cancer or any other malignant diseases, and matched to the age of cases.
reason: The study examines incident histologically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma overall; the abstract does not define or analyze an aggressive incident subtype.
